name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
November 27, 2018
7:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-54
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
i.
Introduction & Presentation of PVEPD Reserve Officers
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 8a-c) All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Demands of November 27, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of November 16, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of November 27, 2018
Demands
3.
PW 668-18; Approval of Plans and Specifications, Waiving of the Bid “Inconsequential” Irregularity and Award of a Construction Contract for the Via Anacapa Sidewalk/Curb Café Extension at Lunada Bay and Miscellaneous Sidewalk Removal and Replacement at Various Locations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the plans and specifications, waive the bid “inconsequential” irregularity and award a construction contract for PW 668-18 Via Anacapa Sidewalk/Curb Café Extension at Lunada Bay and Miscellaneous Sidewalk Removal and Replacement at Various Locations Project, in the amount of $144,550 to FS Contractors, Inc. along with authorization of the $14,455 10% contingency.
Staff Report
4.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
5.
Special Event Application for the Lunada Bay Homeowners’ Association’s “Santa in the Park” Event Scheduled for Wednesday, December 12, 2018
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request of the Lunada Bay Homeowners’ Association to hold its annual “Santa in the Park” on Wednesday, December 12, 2018 from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at Lunada Bay Park and the adjacent street of Via Anacapa contingent on receipt of the complete Certificate of Insurance by 5:00 p.m. on December 7, 2018, as well as permit the posting of promotional signs a week prior to the event.
Staff Report
6.
Approval of Resolutions R18-51, R18-52, and R18-53 Setting Forth Policies and Procedures with Reference to the Compensation and Benefits for Sworn Police Management, Management-Administration, and Professional and Supervisory Personnel
Recommendation: Recommendation: establish the policies and procedures in reference to compensation and benefits for fiscal year 2018-19.
Staff Report
7.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - October 31, 2018
Recommendation: Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
8.
Parklands Committee Recommendations of November 8, 2018
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
PC-515-18; Application to remove 1 Ash tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2517 Via Carrillo
Applicant: Jeff Groves
1133 Via Romero
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to the City Council approval with modification. Reduce the tree to 55 feet above grade, shape the top to be round and trim as necessary to protect safety at the direction of the Urban Forester. (4-0-1 in favor, Kaviani absent).
b.
PC-516-18; Application to remove 2 Canary Island pine trees located in the parkway adjacent to Via Panorama
Applicant:
Via Panorama
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to the City Council denial with modification. Recommend the applicant trim the pine tree away from the roof to reduce needle drop with a tree trimming permit from the City. (4-0-1, in favor, Kaviani absent).
c.
PC-517-18; Application to remove 1 Italian Stone pine tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2546 Palos Verdes Drive West
Applicant: Thomas Olsen
2546 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to the City Council denial of PC-517-18. Recommend the applicant seek advice from the Public Works Department for options to reconstruct this approach and driveway. (3-1-1, in favor, McCabe dissenting, Kaviani absent).
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S)
9.
Reintroduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. 18-734; An Ordinance of the City Council Amending Sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to Define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to Establish Procedures and Standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family Residential Zones
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council reintroduce upon first reading Ordinance No. 18-734 amending sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to establish procedures and standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family residential zones.
Staff Report
10.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval NC-1624/G-1617/M-1258-18; Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading Permit, and Miscellaneous Applications for Additions and Remodeling to the Single-Family Residence and Walls Exceeding the Allowable Height Located at 421 Via Media. Lots 12 & 13, Block 1511, Tract 6886. (Resolution No. PCR-2018-1070) (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
11.
Discussion and Consideration of Proposals for Operation and Maintenance of the Palos Verdes Stable
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council (1) hear 3- to 5-minute presentations by both proposers relative to their interest, goals, objectives, and proposals for operations and maintenance of the PV Stable, (2) discuss what it would like to see in a concession agreement based on a report from the liaisons about the interviews, the reference and financial review by staff, and the presentations, and (3) give direction to the City Council liaisons and staff on what to negotiate with both proposers toward narrowing the selection to one concessionaire.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
12.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
13.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2018, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.

Dated this 21st day of November, 2018.
